name: How does a project manager handle delays outside of anyone’s control?

mainEntity.name: How does a project manager handle delays outside of anyone’s control?

acceptedAnswer.text: When delays arise from weather, supply chain, or inspections, the project manager updates the schedule, resequences work where possible, and communicates realistic revised timelines and options.
